    Server-sent events¶

    rn_forge.fastapi.sse ¶

    Server-sent events over FastAPI.

    Requires the sse extra. Not imported by :mod:rn_forge.fastapi.

    Importing this module imports sse_starlette, which replaces uvicorn.Server.handle_exit for the whole process so that open streams are drained on shutdown (sse_starlette.sse.AppStatus).

    :func:sse_response returns an EventSourceResponse; the media type, the cache-control and x-accel-buffering headers, the heartbeat, disconnect handling and graceful shutdown are its. This module adds validation of frame fields, a terminal error frame, and a retry frame. It does not read Last-Event-ID: the route does, and passes it to the event source.

    DEFAULT_PING_SECONDS = 15.0 module-attribute ¶

    Seconds between heartbeat comments on an idle stream.

    DEFAULT_RETRY_MS = 5000 module-attribute ¶

    Milliseconds a client waits before reconnecting a dropped stream.

    sse_response(events, *, ping=DEFAULT_PING_SECONDS, retry=DEFAULT_RETRY_MS, registry=None, instance='', headers=None, log=None) ¶

    Stream events as text/event-stream.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    events AsyncIterable[ServerSentEvent]

    The frames to send, in order.

    		 required
    ping float | None

    Seconds between heartbeat comments while the stream is idle. None or 0 disables the heartbeat.

    		 DEFAULT_PING_SECONDS
    retry int | None

    Milliseconds a browser EventSource waits before reconnecting. Sent as the first frame; None sends no such frame.

    		 DEFAULT_RETRY_MS
    registry ProblemRegistry | None

    Maps an exception escaping events to its problem. Defaults to :func:~rn_forge.web.default_registry.

    		 None
    instance str

    The problem's instance member.

    		 ''
    headers Mapping[str, str] | None

    Response headers. They are applied last, so each replaces a default of the same name.

    log Log | None

    Called as log("problem.server_error", context) for a 5xx problem, with the exception under "exc", as :func:~rn_forge.fastapi.problem.register_problem_handlers does.

    		 None
